items.label: SOLDIER OF LIGHT
items.why: The BASIC SYS 2064 stub starts two unpacking stages. Their output is the resident program used by the title, selector and all three planet starts.

items.label: track 17, sectors 0-6
items.why: These sectors are the undeclared remainder of one independent 4,172-byte BASIC PRG starting at track 17 sector 0. The linked chain and its line pointers lead to a Compute Publications 1991 human/computer token-removal game. The boot file has a separate directory entry and disjoint chain.
